title: Requirement pinned with a version wildcard
description: requirements.txt declares an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release.
limitation: It matches an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
